text:
maria: Heads up — SolsticeCredit dedicated pool is seeing 5xx/timeouts for checkout calls, started ~16:20 UTC. Customers reporting failed transactions and SLA risk. tagging eng-platform + oncall.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260318-9012 — high error rate for customer SolsticeCredit. Pager duty alerted.
samir: Looking at logs now. initial suspicion: KG cache fill + autoscale not kicking due to sticky routing.
aj: Can you dump inflight requests from pool-42? If p99 token latency is high maybe batch queueing overflow.
lucy: BTW SolsticeCredit is on dedicated-reserved-2 with model version redwood-v2-qt8 pinned.
maria: Correct — they pinned last week for latency. If v2-qt8 is overloaded we can fall back to v1-qt4 temporarily.
aj: I can push a routing policy change to spill to fallback model. Need someone to approve canary and own rollback.
oliver: I'll own the canary. plan: 1) route 5% to v1-qt4 for 10m 2) monitor errors + diff 3) ramp if stable. Anyone object?
tia: Fine with canary. Also we should enable KV prefix caching for their common prompts — that reduces token work.
samir: Quick command to add routing rule:
```
POST /internal/routing/policies
{
  "customer": "solstice-credit",
  "priority": "spill",
  "target_model": "redwood-v1-qt4",
  "percent": 5
}
```
maria: aj will run that. aj ping when done and oliver will trigger canary window.
aj: Running now. will post logs.
aj: Done — routing rule applied. policy-id r-9921. Observing 5% traffic to fallback.
oliver: Canary started. monitoring dashboards: latency looks marginally higher but error rate decreasing from 12% -> 7%.
lucy: Noted: billing/usage may spike on fallback due to extra tokens; CS informed
maria: CS update: Solstice Credit acknowledged and asked for ETA on full mitigation.
oliver: If canary stays <1% error delta over baseline in 15m, I will ramp to 30% then 100% within 40m.
tia: Meanwhile I'll enable prefix caching TTL bump for their route:
```
kubectl exec -c cachectl cache-578 -n infra -- cachectl set-ttl --key-prefix solstice/checkout 1200
```
samir: TTL change applied. early hit rate up from 3% -> 27%.
aj: After ramp to 30% error rate sits at 3.2% — still above SLA target of 0.5% but much better.
maria: We need a long-term fix: investigate why v2-qt8 is degrading under sustained load — telemetry + kernel selection maybe.
oliver: Agreed. I'll open a tech-ticket and assign to eng-runtime. expected triage by EOD.
aj: For immediate closure: propose routing to fallback fully for next 6h and follow up with dedicated capacity bump for Solstice or unpin model.
lucy: CS prefers unpinning over capacity bump. they want predictable perf not extra reserved cost.
tia: I'll draft the customer note and timeline.
maria: Great work. owners: oliver (canary/ramp), aj (routing change), samir (logs/telemetry), tia (customer comms), lucy (billing). Please update this thread with status every 15m until resolved. :white_check_mark:
